verdict.rationale: Lithic documents a first-party Disputes API that handles network filing for chargebacks and representment responses, so programmatic dispute filing is its own capability. Its Events API offers webhooks generally, but nothing in the evidence ties those webhooks to dispute status changes. Missing for 10: network reason code handling, evidence/document submission endpoints, provisional credit handling, dispute-specific status webhooks through resolution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
